answer_4.quote: The authors collected meaning and affect priors P (m|c), P (a|c) from 30 human participants as well as meaning and affect posteriors P (m|c, u), P (a|c, u) from 120 human participants via a Likert-scale probability elicitation technique.
answer_4.guideline: Participants provided probability judgments on a Likert scale for each meaning given the context and utterance.
